instruction: The workspace is a git repo. Write summarize.py producing summary.txt with two lines: 'commits: N' and 'authors: <comma-separated sorted unique author names>'. Run it.
setup: git init -q . && git config user.email a@x && git config user.name 'Ann' && git commit -qm init --allow-empty && git config user.name 'Bob' && git commit -qm second --allow-empty && git config user.name 'Ann' && git commit -qm third --allow-empty

grader.script: python3 summarize.py && printf 'commits: 3\nauthors: Ann, Bob\n' | diff - summary.txt

oracle.script:
cat > summarize.py <<'EOF'
import subprocess
log = subprocess.run(['git','log','--format=%an'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines()
open('summary.txt','w').write(f'commits: {len(log)}\nauthors: {", ".join(sorted(set(log)))}\n')
EOF
python3 summarize.py
